Gradient Variants

Different gradient backgrounds for different AI models or contexts.

HTML

<div class="zak-ai-avatar zak-ai-avatar-md zak-ai-avatar-gradient-blue">...</div>

Status Indicators

Avatars with status dots indicating processing state.

Thinking
Generating
Online
Offline
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-avatar zak-ai-avatar-lg zak-ai-avatar-round" style="position:relative">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>
    <div class="zak-ai-avatar-status thinking"></div>
</div>

<!-- Status classes: thinking, generating, online, offline -->

In Conversation Context

Avatars used alongside name and status in a chat-like layout.

ZAK AI Online · GPT-4
Code Assistant Thinking...
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-avatar-in-chat">
    <div class="zak-ai-avatar zak-ai-avatar-md">âœ¦</div>

        <span class="zak-ai-avatar-in-chat-status">Online &middot; GPT-4</span>

</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-avatar                 /* Base avatar */
.zak-ai-avatar-xs             /* 1.5rem */
.zak-ai-avatar-sm             /* 2rem */
.zak-ai-avatar-md             /* 2.5rem (default) */
.zak-ai-avatar-lg             /* 3.5rem */
.zak-ai-avatar-xl             /* 5rem */
.zak-ai-avatar-round          /* Circular shape */
.zak-ai-avatar-ring           /* Outer ring glow */
.zak-ai-avatar-gradient-blue  /* Blue gradient */
.zak-ai-avatar-gradient-green /* Green gradient */
.zak-ai-avatar-gradient-orange/* Orange gradient */
.zak-ai-avatar-gradient-pink  /* Pink gradient */
.zak-ai-avatar-status         /* Status indicator dot */
.zak-ai-avatar-status.thinking/* Pulsing yellow */
.zak-ai-avatar-status.generating/* Pulsing purple */
.zak-ai-avatar-status.online  /* Solid green */
.zak-ai-avatar-status.offline /* Gray */
.zak-ai-avatar-group          /* Grouped avatars */
.zak-ai-avatar-in-chat        /* Avatar + info layout */
.zak-ai-avatar-in-chat-name   /* Name text */
.zak-ai-avatar-in-chat-status /* Status text */
